title: Add Smithery CLI Installation Instructions
body: This PR adds installation instructions to automatically install MCP MongoDB Server for Claude Desktop using Smithery CLI. This makes it easier for users to install the MCP. Also, it adds a badge to show the number of installations from Smithery.
author: calclavia

title: Add mcp-get installation instructions
body:
Add mcp-get installation instructions

Add documentation for installing the package using mcp-get. This makes it easier for users to discover and install the package through the mcp-get package manager.

Changes:
- Add section for mcp-get installation under Installation
- Include correct command format with @latest tag
- Maintain consistent documentation style and hierarchy
author: michaellatman
